home.title: Find authorization bugs in your API
home.lead: authdiff sends the same requests as different users and compares the answers. A user who can read another user's order, or reach an admin endpoint, shows up as a finding.
home.demo.title: Try the demo lab
home.demo.body: A small, intentionally vulnerable API with fake users and tokens. The scan is ready to run with no setup.
home.own.title: Test your own API
home.own.body: Give a base URL and an OpenAPI spec, add one profile per user or role, review the planned requests, then scan.
home.lab.label: Demo lab status
home.lab.start_hint: Start it from the authdiff repository with one of these commands, then reload this page.

error.400.title: The request could not be read
error.400.body: A form field was missing or had an unexpected value. Go back and try again.
error.401.title: Open authdiff from the terminal link
error.401.body: This page needs the session link that authdiff ui printed in the terminal. Copy the full link, including ?key=, into the address bar. If you restarted authdiff ui, use the new link.
error.403.title: This action was blocked
error.403.body: The form did not come from this authdiff session, so nothing was changed. Reload the page and submit it again.
error.404.title: Page not found
error.404.body: There is nothing at this address.
error.421.title: Wrong address
error.421.body: authdiff only answers at 127.0.0.1 or localhost on the port it printed. Use the link from the terminal.
error.500.title: Something went wrong
error.500.body: authdiff hit an internal error. The details are in the terminal log.
